mapper.select: SELECT a.num, b.amount FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS 'num' FROM `a_hot` a JOIN `a_hot_basic` b ON b.hot_id = a.id AND b.del_flag = 0 JOIN `sys_user_country` uc ON uc.`country_id` = b.`country` WHERE a.del_flag = 0 AND uc.`user_id` = #{userid} AND YEAR(b.create_time) <= #{date} ) a JOIN ( SELECT SUM(IFNULL(c.`pay_amount`,0)) AS 'amount' FROM `a_hot_coop` a LEFT JOIN `a_hot_coop_product` b ON b.`coop_id` = a.`id` AND b.`del_flag` = 0 LEFT JOIN `a_hot_coop_sett` c ON c.`coop_id` = b.`id` AND c.`del_flag` = 0 JOIN `sys_user_country` uc ON uc.`country_id` = a.`country` WHERE a.`del_flag` = 0 AND uc.`user_id` = #{userid} AND YEAR(c.`pay_time`) <= #{date} ) b ON 1=1

SELECT c.`name` AS 'country', COUNT(1) AS 'num' FROM `a_hot` a JOIN `a_hot_basic` b ON b.hot_id = a.id AND b.del_flag = 0 JOIN `sys_user_country` uc ON uc.`country_id` = b.`country` LEFT JOIN `a_country` c ON c.`id` = b.country WHERE a.del_flag = 0 AND uc.`user_id` = #{userid} AND YEAR(b.create_time) <= #{date} GROUP BY c.`name`
